description: Line absorbers' k-distributions per 1 nm cell reduced from the ExoMol line list HyVO for 51V-16O, version 20231218 (rendering plan R08, R08.T4.f; decision-r08-t4ef-storage; decision-r08-t4e-budget; decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md sections 9-11), written by apps/hyperion/scripts/atmosphereData.mjs exomol-k-distributions-merge from the fetched files named here, which are not committed. Adapted material of the ExoMol database, offered under CC BY-SA 4.0 (README.md beside this directory, and NOTICE). The cells are in the binary parts listed, little-endian: HYKD, u16 version, cells, variants, temperatures, pressures and 0; then per cell u16 nm, u16 G, f64 ln sigma (m2 a molecule) of code 1, f64 its step, G f64 weights, and u16 codes over variants x temperaturesK x pressuresPa x g, g fastest, code 0 for sigma 0, else ln sigma = offset + step (code - 1). pressuresPa are air-equivalent broadening pressures; a two-variant table's values are mixed at fixed g by the self share of the Lorentz width. A cell of G = 1 is stored as its mean (decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md section 9).
source: ExoMol line list HyVO for 51V-16O, version 20231218 (C. A. Bowesman, Q. Qu, L. K. McKemmish, S. N. Yurchenko and J. Tennyson, ExoMol line lists - LV: Hyperfine-resolved molecular line list for vanadium monoxide (51V16O), Mon. Not. R. Astron. Soc. 529 (2024) 1321-1332, DOI 10.1093/mnras/stae542), its strong lines as P. E. Cubillos's REPACK holds them (Repacked ExoMol Opacity Line Lists, Zenodo record 14266247, version 3, 2025-09-20, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14266247, threshold 0.01 over 100-3500 K; the method P. E. Cubillos, An Algorithm to Compress Line-transition Data for Radiative-transfer Calculations, Astrophys. J. 850 (2017) 32, ADS 2017ApJ...850...32C); J. Tennyson et al., The 2024 release of the ExoMol database: molecular line lists for exoplanet and other hot atmospheres, J. Quant. Spectrosc. Radiat. Transf. 326 (2024) 109083, DOI 10.1016/j.jqsrt.2024.109083
fetched: 2026-10-30, REPACK's file from Zenodo (its MD5 the record's); HyVO's .def and .pf 2026-10-29 from ExoMol's site
terms: CC BY-SA 4.0, the ExoMol database's licence ('All data in ExoMol is released under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0) licence', https://www.exomol.com/data/licence/, as read 2026-10-29), HyVO being ExoMol's; REPACK's record on Zenodo, its strong lines repacked from HyVO, states CC BY 4.0 (read 2026-10-30); the values here are reduced from them, adapted material offered under CC BY-SA 4.0 (README.md beside this directory, and NOTICE); the line list's files are not committed (decision-r08-licences.md)
reduction: VO's bands (HyVO's strong lines, as Cubillos's REPACK holds them, R08.T4.f), from 1000 K (E2). Each 1 nm vacuum cell's absorption at each node from super-lines: every line's S(T) (ExoMol's intensity formula, Q(T) from the list's .pf, times the isotopologue's natural abundance) binned linearly on a wavenumber grid of a twelfth of the Doppler half-width at 13100 cm-1 (the heaviest isotopologue's where a table takes several), finer than a tenth of the narrowest Voigt half-width; at each node the bins over the cell and 25 cm-1 each side, coarsened by a whole factor while the step stays under a tenth of the node's narrowest Voigt half-width and a 600th of the cut-off (0.042 cm-1), their binning's response divided out, and convolved by FFT with Voigt profiles (Humlicek 1982) cut off 25 cm-1 from each bin at every pressure, at the Doppler widths of the cell's two edges blended linearly in wavenumber; sampled at the cell's points as R08.T4.d's lines are. Every line takes the list's default air width (cm-1 per bar at 296 K, ExoMol's unit), estimated, so that every node's line shape is estimated; sorted into its k-distribution and reduced to two-point Gauss-Legendre g-intervals shared by every node of the cell, by bisection to 8e-4 in T over every column; temperature nodes on E1' (decision-r08-t4e-budget section 1.4: 50 K steps to 1000 K, then each step the largest multiple of 50 K within 10% of its lower node) from the species' floor (decision-r08-t4ef-storage section 1.4, E2), refined by bisection to a quarter of E1's step where the chain test (cubic in T on ln sigma, the client's rows at the standard pressures each read between the table's nodes, the read cubic in ln p on tau) fails 2e-3 within its columns (the gated column, and the species' own Rayleigh column, R08.T4.g's ruling); alternate pressure nodes below 1 MPa dropped where it passes (E3), and an 8-a-decade midpoint added between two held rows below 1 MPa where it fails by the read itself (decision-r08-t4e-unsold's follow-up); ln sigma stored in 16 bits a value (decision-r08-t4d-kdist.md; decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md). Below 1000 K the 1000 K node is held, estimated (decision-r08-t4ef-storage section 1.4, E2: V's refractory condensates cold-trap it below about 1500-2000 K at photospheric pressures). REPACK keeps HyVO's strong lines alone, those whose line-centre opacity passes a hundredth of the other lines' there at some temperature of 100-3500 K (threshold 0.01, Cubillos 2017): 7594976 of its 56903218 records lie in 13100-26400 cm-1, and the weak lines' quasi-continuum is left out (main's ruling of 2026-10-30 waives decision-r08-t4ef-storage section 5.4's no-cut-off rule for VO). Against the pending bound's HyVO cell means (ExoMol's cross-section service, per molecule of 51V16O) the direct sums over the cells above a hundredth of its peak are 0.991, 0.985 and 0.974 summed at 1000, 2000 and 3000 K; cell by cell 0.947-1.008 between the 10th and 90th percentiles and 0.904-1.053 at the extremes (623 and 607 nm; 653 nm), and to 0.83 in a cell at a thousandth of the peak (602 nm at 1000 K), the deficit growing with temperature as the hot weak lines' share does. So the table is measured to 3500 K, REPACK's top, and estimated above it; above 4000 K the 4000 K node is held, estimated, HyVO being valid to 5400 K. Q(T) is HyVO's .pf, and the mass and default width (0.07 cm-1 per bar with n = 0.5, estimated) its .def's. VOMYT (McKemmish et al. 2016) was not taken: its lines carry about half HyVO's strength over the range (0.50 summed, 0.38-0.68 by system, main's research advice).
